digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure / rebar_reconciler import path management
propositions: Three independent copies of the __path__ workaround exist across the codebase: in conftest.py and two inline in top-level test modules, all compensating for the same sys.path shadow
The two inline __path__ append workarounds in test_canonical_consolidation.py and test_code_review_artifact.py are now redundant after the hoisted bridge in tests/unit/conftest.py was added
Removing the two inline copies and relying solely on tests/unit/conftest.py maintains test pass rates and satisfies all acceptance criteria including mixed test execution
The tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py copy is retained as site-local documentation rather than removed, even though it no longer serves a load-bearing function
